spec.title: Profile Settings Feature
spec.description: User profile management page with settings for account information, email confirmation, subscription details, password security, and account deletion.

file.name: ProfileSettingsPage.tsx
file.description: Main profile settings page that combines all sections
file.features: - Header with back navigation - User data fetching on load - Five distinct settings sections displayed vertically

file.name: AccountInformationSection.tsx
file.features: - First name and last name input fields - Email display (read-only) - Form submission with success/error handling - Updates user context on successful save

file.name: EmailConfirmationSection.tsx
file.description: Email verification status and resend functionality
file.features: - Warning banner for unverified emails - Resend confirmation email button - Only visible if email is not verified - Success/error feedback

file.name: SubscriptionSection.tsx
file.description: Compact subscription plan display and upgrade option
file.features: - Compact one-line display at top of page - Free users: "Looks like your plan's asking for a promotion" + Upgrade button - Premium users: "You are Premium" + Premium chip with gradient - Opens PaywallModal on upgrade button click - Outlined upgrade button with TrendingUp icon

file.name: PasswordSecuritySection.tsx
file.features: - Current password verification - New password input with confirmation - Password mismatch detection - Success/error feedback - No complexity requirements enforced

file.name: DeleteAccountSection.tsx
file.features: - Warning banner about consequences - Password confirmation field - Confirmation modal dialog - Account anonymization on delete - Automatic logout after deletion - Redirect to home page

endpoint.description: Change user password with current password verification

access_point.description: Clicking on user avatar navigates to Profile Settings page
access_point.behavior: Direct navigation to /profile-settings instead of opening sidebar

access_point.description: Arrow back button returns to /refine page

styling.cards: White cards with subtle shadows and rounded corners

translations.sections: - accountInfo (title, fields, buttons, messages) - emailConfirmation (title, warning, button, messages) - subscription (title, plan details, button) - passwordSecurity (title, fields, requirements, messages) - deleteAccount (title, warning, modal, messages)
